title: Make things easy, do not make them difficult
arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
latin: Yassiru wa la tu'assiru, wa bashshiru wa la tunaffiru
translation: Make things easy, make not difficult. Give glad tidings and do not drive people away.
lesson: Islam is ease. If your preaching drives people away, revisit your method. The Prophet was gentle.
